actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
New complete hand-drawn cel-anime illustration of the full character in image 1, with precisely the same pose, clothes, facial expression, hand anatomy and weapon silhouettes. Image 2 explains the DARK dagger's separate external pieces only. Keep one whole character and both whole daggers, plain white background.

Correct this one visibly incorrect detail in image 1: at the LOW hand (the full black glove with red wrist cuff), the pointed black pommel containing the orange mark must join a completely BLACK grip. The small band between the fingers and that pommel, around image coordinates x327–344 y659–683, is BLACK, matching the grip and pommel. The whole visible handle area on that side of the fist is solid dark material except the orange inset. There is no colored ring at the pommel end.

The dagger's actual red collar sits at its other end next to the guard, mostly occluded by the thumb and guard. Do not move it toward the pommel to expose it. Preserve the red wedge farther along the blade. The opposite raised ivory dagger and its correct reverse grip must stay unchanged: unique pommel above thumb, unique guard and red collar below little finger. Preserve the continuous orange left sock and white right sock, the current asymmetric wrists, body proportions, equipment and current large daggers. Render the entire image freshly, with clean lines and broad hard-shadow color fields, without noisy white patches. No labels, extra body parts, extra handles or extra weapons.
